name: Hiring-pipeline correlation signals that document checks miss

attribution.legal_posture: Source-attributed defensive research finding; adjudication and independent dispositive force require separate evidence.

ttps: Correlate candidate artifacts across ATS, identity verification, interview telemetry, address collection, and known network-risk context rather than treating a passed background check as proof of operator identity.
caveats: Signals are non-exclusive and require safeguards against demographic or nationality-proxy use.
The source is a vendor blog and should be paired with case-specific or official provenance where available.

statements: Nisos lists mirrored job-description language, multiple same-name resume accounts with inconsistent histories, VoIP numbers, VPN-associated IPs, pauses or off-screen glances during interviews, and abrupt logoff when asked to share a screen as analyst-visible signals.

sources.support: Nisos lists mirrored job-description language, multiple same-name resume accounts with inconsistent histories, VoIP numbers, VPN-associated IPs, pauses or off-screen glances during interviews, and abrupt logoff when asked to share a screen as analyst-visible signals
